scope: Own exterior industrial-design variant. Core cavity, hardware/port datums, cooling openings and all functions unchanged. Original delivery is immutable.

front_recess.scope: Cuts only added exterior stock back to the unchanged Y0 connector/front-fastener datum; dark fascia is a face coating.

cartridge_well.scope: 0.6mm shallow exterior recess. Apertures/contact geometry unchanged; remaining overall lid thickness2.4mm in well. No separate trim insert or new fastener.

thermal_scope: No fan or changed vent area. Larger exterior and changed finish are not treated as measured thermal improvement. Existing thermal study remains the baseline sensitivity, not restyled-casing qualification.
mechanical_scope: Original PCB, native components, card bank, controls, fasteners and wiring remain. Targeted shell/service-boundary sanity only; no electrical rebuild.

waist_groove.scope: Solid shallow exterior shadowline only; retained interior circle/rectangle lies outside original cavity, no ventilation perforation or separate body joint.

rear_recess.scope: Exterior stock removed back to unchanged190mm rear mating plane; retains existing rear openings/ventilation and full manufacturer/plug envelopes.

outer_profile: Ruled rounded-rectangle shoulder bands: intentional crisp moulding creases, not unconstrained freeform spline.
